newsitem.title: MEXICO: Radio Centro up sharply on Q2 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Radio Centro up sharply on Q2 earnings.

text.p: Shares listed by Mexican broadcasting company Grupo Radio Centro were up sharply at mid-morning trade on the Mexican bourse on Thursday following earnings and dividend news, dealers and analysts said.
Radio Centro CPO shares were up 1.24 pesos to 13.30 pesos, while its ADRs had gained 1-1/8 to 15.

Radio Centro reported second quarter operating earnings on Wednesday that were up almost five times year-ago figures. The company also announced it would pay 20 million pesos in a cash dividend and would propose paying further dividends of 32 million pesos.
"(It was) an attention-grabbing second quarter," Francisco Rivero, an analyst at Valores Finamex, said in a report.
